R2_follow_exited_early_and_mistook_absen.multibyte: a bounded read ending mid-sequence decoded with `replace`, so every character straddling a slice boundary was destroyed and the caller could not tell -- `bytes_read` counted the bytes handed over rather than the bytes that decoded. `_whole` holds back a trailing incomplete sequence and reports only what decoded, so the next slice resumes at the character boundary. At true end of file nothing is held back, because a truncated sequence there is the writer's and a follower that waited for it would never finish.
